question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Occurence"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Occurrence**".
 
• **"Occurrence"** means an event or an instance of something happening. (घटना)
 
 
• **Example: **The **occurrence** of the solar eclipse was a rare event that fascinated everyone.**​**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Immediately** (तुरंत): At once; instantly.

 
 
• **Example:** She called the doctor **immediately **when she felt unwell.
 
 
 
• **Grateful** (आभारी): Feeling or showing an appreciation of kindness.
 
 
• **Example: **She was **grateful** for the support she received from her friends.
 
 
 
• **Parallel** (समानांतर): Two lines or paths that are the same distance apart along their whole length.
 
 
• **Example:** The railway tracks run **parallel **to the highway.
